body:
My friend Kris and I recently came across a LARGE amount of TMA-2.  My friend is very unexperienced with psychedelics.  He mostly has only taken weed, coke, and meth.  He once took some really weak mushrooms, but thats about it.  I on the other hand have used a wide variety of drugs including weed, coke, speed, ketamine, ecstacy, mushrooms, heroin, and pretty much every other major illegal drug except pcp and Lsd.  But anyway, We were at my friend Josh's work where we decided to try some TMA-2.  I have done a great deal of research on it and knew it was very potent, so I sniffed a small line and swollowed a small amount on a piece of paper towel, probably about 40mg.  Kris on the other hand is used to sniffing large lines of meth and decided that he wanted a larger amount than the small pile  I consumed, he probably took about 90mg.  We left josh's work for our friend Bob's house.  Bob is a single father with a 14 month old son, Dill.
The next two hours were awesome, tracers, colors, everything was going fine, until Kris started to wig out.  At first he would be talking and just in the middle of a sentence would say 'HELP, I mean not help but...'  and would go silent.  He did this about 15 times in the next hour.  Then things really took a bad turn.  He heard the baby cry and totally freaked.  He kept asking why is Dill crying in a panicked voice and would get up and wander around the house frantically.  He then stated that this drug made him insane and it ruined his life.  About an hour later he was GONE.  He kept SCREAMING  'Help!!!, not me, Dill and everyone.  THE FIRE!!!!, WE ARE ALL DEAD!!!'  Which needless to say wasn't cool for me, I was tripping HARD.  He would not respond to anything we tried to tell him.  He was shouting at the top of his lungs, 'HELP, WE ARE ALL DEAD!!!!! THE FIRE!!!'  We kept telling him to shut up or the cops would come thinking someone needed help.  He then tried to run out side screaming, but Bob stopped him.
Kris puked on the floor then started to try and fight Bob while yelling some crazy stuff.  Bob tackeld him and rolled around with him in the puke on the floor.  I helped hold him down and tried to cover his mouth.  But we couldn't hold him forever.  So we decided we needed to call the cops.  While Bob held him I called for an ambulence and police.  About 5 police responded and helped hold him down until the ambulence came. The cops said they never saw someone trip so bad.  Even with the cops there holding him it was like he was in a different world he wouldn't answer any questions either we or the police would ask he just kept screaming 'WE ARE ALL DEAD!'
The cops hauled him to the ambulence and they all left.  Later a cop came by to talk to us about what happened. I told him he said he took somthing like acid called TMA-2.  They said they gave him a valium injection but it had no effect on him, and he still thought we were all dead.  Now it has been 3 days and my friend is nowhere to be found I think he might be crazy now.  He really snapped.  TMA could have been a really fun drug but I doubt I will ever touch it again after that whole experience.
